findings.evidence: The cited docstrings state the migration obligation; `rg` confirms the five paths are absent from TauCeti/mathlib-shims.json, while SELF_DECLARED and its fallback patterns only match “temporary shim,” “when Mathlib … deleted,” “migrate to Mathlib and delete,” or “copy … deleted … Mathlib.”
findings.fix: Recognize this “should be refactored/deleted when upstream lands” wording and add registry entries with suitable speculative or landing-sentinel probes for all five files.
findings.issue: The prose patterns miss five Schwarz–Pick files that explicitly require migration when upstream equivalents land: AutomorphismIsometry:31–32, Basic:36–37, Derivative:32–33, Isometry:38–40, and Rigidity:59–61. None appears in mathlib-shims.json, so future upstream replacements remain invisible.

summary: The coverage detector misses several explicit upstream-obsolescence declarations, so the registry cannot make all temporary surfaces self-expiring.
